description: Identifier-dense tokens both speech normalizers must agree on (#119207). Unspeakable machine tokens become silence — never hardcoded English placeholder words (#86602). identifier_tokens: [text, mustNotContain[], mustContain[]] — prose around a replaced token must survive. pass_through_tokens: [text, mustContain[]] — ordinary speech must pass verbatim. IPv4 decision: a dotted quad with octets 0-255 (optionally :port, 1-5 digits) is silence on both sides; three-component versions (1.2.3) and out-of-range quads (999.1.1.1) are not IPv4 and stay. Hostname decision: a LOWERCASE token with a digit and a hyphen (pve-3, node-01) is a machine name and becomes silence; uppercase digit+hyphen words (COVID-19, GPT-4) stay spoken, and digit-only names without a hyphen (pve3) stay spoken.
